newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - At Home Corp.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - At Home Corp.

text.p: At Home Corp filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering for eight million series A, common shares worth about $64.4 million.
The Redwood City, Calif., company offered the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 1.2 million additional shares.
The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Hambrecht & Quist, the company said in the filing.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital and capital expenditures.
At Home is a provider of Internet Services for the cable television infrastructure to consumers and businesses.
